summary.text: Robert Thorne Jr. is the Republican candidate for the Arkansas House of Representatives, District 35, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Democrat Audrey Willis in a race with no incumbent.
He won the 2024 Republican primary for the seat and lost that year's general election to Democrat Jessie McGruder.
